confidence_notes: Food estimates use [Numbeo's 2026 Palermo prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Palermo) and a [local nightlife guide](https://eurocityguide.com/italy/palermo-nightlife-guide). Cocktail and wine estimates also reflect their approximate prices relative to beer. July lodging prices are less certain and are holistic estimates that account for summer demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Catania and other southern Italian cities provide a regional basis, adjusted for Palermo's size and July tourism demand.
